# zapleo — Dmitriy Zaporozhets

> Operator-turned-educator. 12 years of Ukrainian web agency work, now running an IT academy branch in Jakarta. Personal site at zapleo.com.

## About

Dmitriy Zaporozhets is a software operator and EdTech professional based in Jakarta, Indonesia. He founded a web agency in Dnipro, Ukraine in 2010, delivered 40+ client projects over 12 years, then pivoted to education — currently serving as Branch Director at IT STEP Academy Jakarta (since April 2026).

His public persona (handle: @zapleosoft, brand: zapleo) sits at the intersection of software engineering, operator-level business management, and AI-augmented education.

## Languages

Site available in English, Ukrainian (/uk/), Russian (/ru/), Bahasa Indonesia (/id/).

## Projects

- AI Sales Assistant — conversational AI for sales channels (Instagram DMs, Telegram, WhatsApp). Qualifies leads 24/7, handles objections, books appointments. Includes a coach interface: business owners update scripts and product knowledge without code. Live in production in Jakarta. Available as a custom build for other businesses. Case study: https://zapleo.com/work/ai-sales-assistant/
- AIbroker — centralized LLM API key broker (FastAPI, PostgreSQL, LiteLLM). Self-hosted on Hetzner. Proxy mode + vending mode. Per-project cost caps, health monitoring, Telegram alerts. Case study: https://zapleo.com/work/aibroker/
- Pasijou — coworking + restaurant + cinema hybrid in Weligama, Sri Lanka. Operator role. Tripadvisor 4.9. Case study: https://zapleo.com/work/pasijou/
- apcu.ua — industry portal for the Ukrainian Cosmetics & Perfumery Association. Custom WordPress, live since 2018. Case study: https://zapleo.com/work/apcu/

## Services

Zapleo builds custom AI assistants for businesses with high-volume inbound sales channels. Key capabilities: multi-channel conversational AI (Instagram, Telegram, WhatsApp, web), real-time coach interface for non-technical training, CRM integration, lead qualification flows, escalation logic. Contact: dima@zapleo.com
